symptom.detail: semantic repair cannot mutate immutable semantic identity: obligation_id='OBL-PRODUCT-TESTS':fields=['path']

dynamic_evidence.proposed_shape: same obligation id, same role/owner/applicability, second authorized physical test path
dynamic_evidence.guard_result: correctly rejected as an immutable path mutation before normalization

root_cause.summary: The typed semantic composer treated unambiguous delivery-depth group-id reuse as moving an existing artifact instead of splitting one semantic group into two physical artifacts.

behavior: Only during delivery-depth repair, preserve the baseline artifact row.
When path is the only changed identity field and owner/role/applicability match, mint a deterministic artifact-normalized-* id for the authorized new path.
Atomically expand verifier and behavior obligation references from the group id to the original and minted ids.
Keep owner, role, applicability, unauthorized path, duplicate path, and non-depth identity mutations fail-closed.

residual_risk: A fresh provider may produce a genuinely ambiguous semantic mutation; those shapes remain fail-closed and must not be normalized.
